description: This PHP file defines the CandidateListModel class within the OrangeHRM Recruitment module API. It models the data structure for candidate listing, including candidate details, associated vacancy information, and attachment status for API responses.

classes.name: CandidateListModel
classes.description: A model representing candidate information for API responses within the recruitment module, encapsulating candidate details, vacancy info, and attachment status.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the CandidateListModel instance into an associative array suitable for JSON serialization, including candidate details, vacancy info, attachment presence, and deletability status.
